intro: Quartermaster Lewis is a human supply merchant stationed at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. Serving the local People's Militia, he provides rations, ammunition, and everyday provisions to travelers and defenders attempting to hold the frontier against the Defias Brotherhood.

p: Perched inside Sentinel Tower, Quartermaster Lewis manages the meager logistical lifeline of the Westfall militia. With Stormwind's royal leadership offering little aid to the impoverished region, Sentinel Hill relies on local volunteers and whatever supplies they can gather. Lewis distributes standard field necessities, from dry rations and fresh water to arrows, shot, and throwing blades, ensuring the fighters standing watch have the bare essentials to survive Defias raids.
